category_title: Students who sleep during the course and challenge teacher directives when woken
scenario_title: Aimless disengagement and sleeping during active instruction
minimal_context: The student is expected to follow along with the teaching material on the board during active instructional time in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the board and follow along with the teaching material for today's lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks directly at your face without any goals, showing interest in everything except the teaching material.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Are you going to look at the material?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes out a mobile phone and starts listening to music instead of following the lesson.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please put that away and focus on the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to ignore the teaching material, puts his head down on the table, and goes to sleep in the classroom.)
